name: George Cole
role: Representative of the N. P. Refrigerator Car Co.
bio: George Cole appears in the Cow Boy in 1885 and 1886. In April 1886, as the company's representative, he had the papers served in the injunction stopping Stark County's treasurer from collecting taxes in Billings County.

moments.label: Served injunction papers on Stark County's treasurer

mentions: Geo. E. Cole left for St. Paul yesterday to superintend the closing up of the St. Paul branch of the N. P. R. C. Co. All books and papers will be brought here and in the future, the…
Geo. A. Cole returned Saturday night from St. Paul, where he closed the office of the N. P. Ref. Car Co. The headquarters of the company will hereafter be in Medora.
…as also had an injunction issued, restraining Stark Co's. treasurer from collecting taxes of Billings county. George Cole, as representative of the Co. had the papers served yesterday.
Geo. E. Cole has returned from his eastern trip, having made a flying visit to his old home and other points of interest.
